description: Free sample: https://apexfaucet.xyz/delivery-score?url=https://apexfaucet.xyz/api/x402/page-markdown ($0.003). Score one https x402 URL from 0 to 100. Five parts of 0 to 20: watchtower 7-day uptime for that exact URL, a valid unpaid 402, the USDC price, how fast that probe was, and test buys we already recorded. This call does not pay the URL. A URL we have never bought scores 0 on test buys and says so. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

url.description: https x402 URL to score. This call does not pay it.
